ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-level distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white/cream) and 60% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric high-intensity contiguous regions covering the distal half of both lobes, bifurcated by a solid low-intensity central meridian and leading-edge border. Heavy low-intensity linear mottling disrupts the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75-80 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most aggressive on the outer thirds of both lobes, displaying jagged peaks and narrow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature with a slight upward/posterior sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of dark, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions; distinct sets of 4-5 parallel rake marks are visible on the distal white sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent tooth-rake scarring across the ventral surface of both lobes; minor irregular tissue loss/jaggedness on the outer distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense 'cross-hatch' pattern formed by intersecting linear abrasions on the inner distal section of the left lobe (viewer's perspective).
